_comment: Featured projects, in README order. Descriptions are written specifically for Rahul's actual GitHub projects.

projects.description: A full-stack AI research assistant that lets users upload PDFs, retrieve relevant information with FAISS vector search, and ask Gemini-powered questions grounded in their documents. Built with FastAPI, React, Sentence Transformers, FAISS, JWT authentication, and SQLite.

A full-stack visual AI workflow builder for creating, executing, and monitoring multi-step agentic workflows with LLM calls, HTTP requests, conditional logic, database actions, notifications, scheduled triggers, and human approval gates.

GreenCart is a full-stack grocery delivery platform with product discovery, search, cart management, saved addresses, order history, secure authentication, Stripe payments, and a dedicated seller dashboard for inventory and order management.

A full-stack admin and client management portal with separate frontend and backend applications, designed to streamline business workflows through centralized administration, client management, and role-based operations.

A modern HR management platform for employee workflows, attendance, leave requests, payroll, and AI-assisted HR operations, with role-based access control and offline-first functionality for resilient local operation.

DocuMind is a multi-user document intelligence platform combining OCR, structured document extraction, and RAG-based question answering to understand invoices, receipts, identity documents, resumes, and other business documents.

A backend engineering assignment focused on understanding an unfamiliar Express API, identifying bugs, implementing task assignment functionality, and building automated tests with Jest for reliable REST API behavior.
A Python data engineering project that extracts weather data, transforms it into structured datasets, and processes the results through an ETL workflow for analysis and downstream use.
